name: Crash Team Racing: Turbocharged
summary: A PC port of Crash Team Racing, built on the community decompilation. It runs natively on Windows and Linux at up to 240 FPS, in widescreen, with a cleaned-up renderer. Or with the original PS1 look, if that’s what you prefer.
